page_title: SOU 1-2 FUL | Southampton v Fulham 26/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Tony Harrington has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Ryan Manning (Southampton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+5' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes.
90+2' 1 - 2 Goooooal! Adama Traore beats his man and slings in a cross towards Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham), who evades his marker and plants a fine header inside the left post from close in. 1:2.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Joachim Andersen (Fulham) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
90' Tom Cairney (Fulham) steps up to send the ball in.

89' Adama Traore (Fulham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.

88' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and James Bree (Southampton) comes onto the pitch so that Mateus Fernandes can be given a rest.
86' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Tom Cairney (Fulham) replaces Alex Iwobi.
86' Harry Wilson goes off the pitch and Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) comes on.
86' Harry Wilson (Fulham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

86' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) drives a shot towards the left side of the goal from inside the box, but Aaron Ramsdale leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away. The ball is out of play. Fulham win a corner kick.
83' Adama Traore (Fulham) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
83' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes it short.
82' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.
81' Adama Traore (Fulham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
79' Kenny Tete (Fulham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Aaron Ramsdale comes off the line to clear the ball away.
78' Substitution. Tyler Dibling (Southampton) has come on for Kamaldeen Sulemana.
77' Ryan Manning (Southampton) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
76' The resulting corner from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
75' Harry Wilson (Fulham) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
74' A cross into the box from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is cleared.
72' 1 - 1 Goal! Alex Iwobi plays it to Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Aaron Ramsdale. 1:1.
70' Tony Harrington shows the yellow card to Raul Jimenez (Fulham) for a heavy challenge.
69' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
68' Cameron Archer (Southampton) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
66' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) replacing Willian.
66' Substitution. Ross Stewart makes way for Cameron Archer (Southampton).
65' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
64' The game is interrupted as Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is flagged offside.
63' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
62' Willian (Fulham) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.

61' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Bernd Leno makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
60' Willian (Fulham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
58' Jack Stephens (Southampton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' The resulting corner from Willian (Fulham) is cleared.
56' Willian (Fulham) blows a good opportunity to score. Without hesitation he fires in a shot from mid range, but the ball crashes against the left post!
55' Ross Stewart (Southampton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' Willian (Fulham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

54' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Jan Bednarek (Southampton) is penalised for holding. Tony Harrington signals a set piece.
51' A first-time shot by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
50' Adama Traore (Fulham) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Aaron Ramsdale comes off the line to clear the ball away.
49' Willian (Fulham) plays a through ball but overhits it.
48' Kenny Tete (Fulham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
46' The game is over for Andreas Pereira (Fulham). Adama Traore comes on for the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Silva gives a chance to Sasa Lukic and Sander Berge (Fulham) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Flynn Downes (Southampton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
43' The corner kick from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

43' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Aaron Ramsdale reads it well and gathers the ball.
42' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
41' Ross Stewart (Southampton) was too forceful with his tackle and Tony Harrington interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
40' The possession of the ball – 41:59.
38' Jack Stephens (Southampton) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
37' The ball is cleared after Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' A pass from Kenny Tete (Fulham) is intercepted by Aaron Ramsdale and the move breaks down.
35' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

33' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Bernd Leno, who tips the ball around the post.
31' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
31' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

30' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
29' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Aaron Ramsdale has no trouble gathering it.
28' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Now Fulham have a corner.
27' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
25' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) commits a foul during an attacking move.
24' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
23' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
22' Tony Harrington interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton).
21' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
21' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
21' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) meets a cross and produces a header towards the right side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
21' There's an opportunity for Andreas Pereira (Fulham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
20' A lofted cross from Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
19' Ross Stewart (Southampton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' Willian (Fulham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
17' Tony Harrington has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
16' Jack Stephens (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

14' 1 - 0 Jack Stephens (Southampton) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header low inside the right post.
12' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Willian (Fulham) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
11' Neat passing move from Fulham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Southampton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
4' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is flagged for offside.
4' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

3' Willian (Fulham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Fulham will take a corner kick.
2' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Southampton will kick-off.
Tony Harrington will referee today's match.
